persistence.note: previous tick's target within the session; first tick uses the train mean

input.path: hub:rmems/Spikenaut-SNN-Telemetry v3/state_telemetry/{train,validation,test}-00000.parquet projected to episode_id + five live columns, file order (see docs/recurrence/README.md)

protocol.primary: mean over the three heads of the session-weighted MAE (equal weight per session) in target units [0, 1]; lower is better
protocol.readout_fit: ridge on emitted spike vectors, no bias, outgoing-Dale sign box (E >= 0, I <= 0) solved by Lawson-Hanson NNLS on the normal equations, weights snapped to the Q8.8 grid; lambda = lambda_rel * n_train_ticks chosen on the validation split

recurrence_contract.family: I->E lateral inhibition at one gain; E->E, E->I, I->I, self = 0
recurrence_contract.order: input = W@stim (+ I_DRIVE on Dale-I rows) + R@s(t-1); v = keep*v + input; fire; optional K-WTA; reset winners; s(t-1) is the emitted (post-K-WTA) spike vector
recurrence_contract.state: v and s(t-1) reset together at every episode_id boundary; the first tick of a session has zero feedback

protocol.session_reset: membrane and previous-spike state reset at each episode_id boundary
protocol.stepper: tools/hamming_lif.py keep_lif_step on the Q8.8 grid; recurrent arms via tools/recurrent_lif.py recurrent_lif_step
protocol.target: Distill sample_readout_target: (comfort, temp, power) with temp = gpu_temp_c axon, power = power_w axon, comfort = clamp(1 - 0.5*temp - 0.5*power, 0, 1), binary32

verdict_vs_ff_refit.criterion: >= 5% lower test primary than the refit feed-forward arm and no head > 5% worse; selection on validation only
